text:
Megan L.: kicking off a small config-only micro-roll to tame evening tail spikes. no model or infra changes. change-id cfg-2026-03-23-stagger1. plan: staggered canary (phase1 3% 30m -> phase2 10% 45m), keys: routing.safety_sieve=on, batch.window_ms 20->11, tenant_multiplier=0.96, request_timeout_ms 30000->30800. DeployBot: config-only deploy queued: cfg-2026-03-23-stagger1, phase1=3%/30m, initiated by Megan L.. monitor: https://console.redwood/changes/cfg-2026-03-23-stagger1 OpsBot: phase1 started at 1748472365; streaming logs -> https://ops.redwood/dash/cfg-2026-03-23-stagger1
Sofia: seeing small p95 uptick (~+14%) on a handful of canary hosts after 9m. batch p50 down 3->1.9. log snippet: ```batching.hist p50=3->1.9; p95_ms=195->223``` Tom: smaller window reduces coalescing; cost risk. recommend tenant carve-outs for top traffic slices. Megan L.: agree. pin the top 4 tenants (live-core, billing, search-main, storefront) to cfg-prev and keep phase1 at 3% elsewhere. DeployBot: pins applied: live-core,billing,search-main,storefront -> cfg-prev (action cfg-2026-03-23-pins)
Ravi: add auto-rollback triggers: errors>0.6% OR p95_delta>28% sustained 8m. attach to phase1. DeployBot: rollback rule attached to cfg-2026-03-23-stagger1: errors>0.6% OR p95_delta>28% for 8m -> AUTO-ROLLBACK
Sofia: after pins, pinned tenants stable. phase1 cohort p95 delta down to ~10%, errors 0.03%. recommend shrink phase1 to 2% and extend observation to 75m before phase2. Megan L.: ok adjust to phase1=2%/75m; update change doc with exact keys, pin list, cost note and runbook. DeployBot: canary adjusted: phase1=2%/75m by Megan L.; change doc updated: "routing.safety_sieve=on; batch.window_ms 20->11; tenant_multiplier 0.96; request_timeout_ms 30000->30800; pinned: live-core,billing,search-main,storefront; rollback rules attached; staggered canary: phase1 2%/75m -> phase2 10%/45m"
Priya: adding a short runbook in the change doc: ```1) if AUTO-ROLLBACK: POST /deploy/rollback -d '{"change_id":"cfg-2026-03-23-stagger1"}' 2) verify pins: GET /config/pins -> ensure listed tenants on cfg-prev 3) notify #eng-sre and #product 4) monitor metrics for 30m 5) open incident if errors>1% for 10m``` OpsBot: alert rule created: page if errors>3x baseline OR sustained p95_delta>40% for 15m -> https://ops.redwood/alerts/9982
Tom: please annotate expected cost impact in the doc (likely small uptick on high QPS tenants). Megan L.: done. Charlie: (cc) holding off on any routing or QoS PRs until this window completes. Megan L.: thanks  if anyone sees >0.5% errors or other anomalies, call rollback immediately and @channel. reconvene after observation window to decide on phase2 ramp timing. :white_check_mark:
